parameters.proof_scope: No resolution of general Conjecture 5 or asymptotic Conjecture 1; certificates rely on Jordan theorem and independently verified primitivity
parameters.row_rule: For each even k, use the first three primes p>k+1 with k+p>100 and k+p=3 mod4; stop after the first fully classified row with k+1 symmetric triples; test every m in k+1..n-1
parameters.success: An exact checked finite row witness for every selected k; unknown classifications never count as proper or symmetric

policy.result_selection: Retain every attempted row and failure; no tuning after observation
policy.variants: Only parameter variants explicitly enumerated here
